annotation.title_clean: The Proposed Regulation of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics in Kenya: An Appraisal of the Kenya Robotics and Artificial Intelligence Association Bill, 2023
annotation.title_en: The Proposed Regulation of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics in Kenya: An Appraisal of the Kenya Robotics and Artificial Intelligence Association Bill, 2023
annotation.venue: Journal of Conflict Management and Sustainable Development (Journalofcmsd) 11(3)
annotation.summary_en: Journal article appraising Kenya's proposed Robotics and Artificial Intelligence Association Bill, 2023. It reviews regulatory challenges and global trends, identifies the bill's merits (a professional body) and demerits (limited scope, no guiding principles, weak enforcement), and proposes amendments drawing on international practice.
key_provisions_or_claims: Bill establishes a professional association advising government and formulating industry standards
Bill's regulatory scope is limited and lacks guiding principles
Recommends mandatory AI system inventory and disclosure
Recommends mandatory inter-agency collaboration and clear regulatory principles
